comment: Playbook §24.4 questionnaire for every managed session kind. This matrix is the G9 session-ownership smoke check, not full release-close (symbol / storage / capability ratchets are separate).

Companion.owner: Owning Work session (CompanionHost.primaryId / SatelliteSpec ownerSessionId). InternalLeaf + Attached(Companion).
Companion.reusable: Yes. SatelliteRuntime.Ensure reuses the journal RestoredSessionId child when exactly one Host child matches agent+title (HOST-015). No journal link never adopts a sibling; always create.
Companion.cancel: Owner cascade: SatelliteRuntime AbortSession on link failure and on Retire; owner delete/cancel tears down the leaf. Not a public Handle cancel.
Companion.retire: SatelliteRuntime.Retire: AbortSession the lease then spec.Close (durable unlink) and Invalidate the in-flight Ensure.
Companion.handle: No. Companion is not a public Handle and does not enter Handle/list/join.
Companion.companion: No. InternalLeaf must not hold a Companion (COMPANION-002 CompanionWouldRecurse).
Companion.crashReconcile: SessionRecoveryWorkflow.defaultRecoverBlogger via BloggerCrashRecovery.reconcile. SatelliteRuntime.Ensure reuses the journal-linked child, Replacement if Host proves it gone, fail closed on query/conflict.

SyncInspector.owner: Owning Work session (ownerSessionId). DedicatedDelegateKey = (OwnerReuseScopeId, Inspector). Work + Attached(SyncInspector).
SyncInspector.reusable: Yes. At most one live dedicated Session per (scope, Inspector). AttachedSessionRuntime.GetOrCreate reuses a still-usable binding.
SyncInspector.cancel: Owner session cancel (SyncDelegateRuntime DiagnosticWait CancelledBy owner-session + SessionLifetime). Owner abort fails in-flight Returned/Completion.
SyncInspector.retire: AttachedSessionRuntime.Remove / RemoveByDelegateSession plus owner cascade abort/retire. Not a public Handle consume.
SyncInspector.handle: No. Dedicated SyncInspector does not enter public Handle/list/join.
SyncInspector.companion: MAY. Work+Attached may hold its own Companion (Work capability path). Not InternalLeaf.
SyncInspector.crashReconcile: Rebind via AttachedSessionRuntime when the Host child is still usable; otherwise create a replacement Work child. Durable association + HOST-015 fail-closed recovery. Returned→Completion is call algebra, not a second ownership map.

SyncCoder.owner: Owning Work session (ownerSessionId). DedicatedDelegateKey = (OwnerReuseScopeId, Coder). Work + Attached(SyncCoder).
SyncCoder.reusable: Yes. At most one live dedicated Session per (scope, Coder). AttachedSessionRuntime.GetOrCreate reuses a still-usable binding.
SyncCoder.cancel: Owner session cancel (SyncDelegateRuntime DiagnosticWait CancelledBy owner-session + SessionLifetime). Owner abort fails in-flight Returned/Completion.
SyncCoder.retire: AttachedSessionRuntime.Remove / RemoveByDelegateSession plus owner cascade abort/retire. Not a public Handle consume.
SyncCoder.handle: No. Dedicated SyncCoder does not enter public Handle/list/join.
SyncCoder.companion: MAY. Work+Attached may hold its own Companion (Work capability path). Not InternalLeaf.
SyncCoder.crashReconcile: Rebind via AttachedSessionRuntime when the Host child is still usable; otherwise create a replacement Work child. Durable association + HOST-015 fail-closed recovery. Returned→Completion is call algebra, not a second ownership map.

Bookkeeper.owner: Owning Work session (ownerSessionId). InternalLeaf + Attached(Bookkeeper of transactionId). BookkeeperRuntime.bindSession records sessionId→txId with AttachmentKind.Bookkeeper txId.
Bookkeeper.reusable: No across transactions. One CreateChildSession per Guid txId; bound to that transactionId and must not mix with Companion or Sync* identity.
Bookkeeper.cancel: BookkeeperRuntime.retire: AbortSession the CreateChildSession child then unbindSession. Invoked on SendPrompt failure, timeout, or terminal Failed/Aborted. Not an in-process digest cancel and not a public Handle cancel.
Bookkeeper.retire: BookkeeperRuntime.retire after BookkeeperStaging.take (success) or abort: AbortSession then unbindSession. Transaction-local CreateChildSession leaf, not in-process digest and not a public Handle consume.
Bookkeeper.handle: No. Bookkeeper must not enter public Handle/list/join.
Bookkeeper.companion: No. InternalLeaf does not hold a Companion.
Bookkeeper.crashReconcile: Process-local live map is not durable lifecycle authority. After crash do not reuse the child; next CaseRefresh/CaseFinalize creates a new InternalLeaf via CreateChildSession with a new txId. Not in-process digest. This questionnaire is still not full G9 release-close.
Bookkeeper.notes: G6 landed BookkeeperRuntime.fs: one CreateChildSession per transaction, edit-qa against process-local staging, then AbortSession. OpenCodeChildOptions stays {Title, Agent, Directory}. CasebookBookkeeper synthesizer/digest is gone; refreshStale calls runTransaction CaseRefresh. AttachmentKind.Bookkeeper remains declared on SessionOwnership.fs.

hidden Reviewer.owner: Host-owned Finality workflow. HostForkRuntime is constructed with HandleOwnership.HostOwnedHidden (FinalityHostPort); the Reviewer is not owned by the Manager list/join surface.
hidden Reviewer.reusable: Ungraduated historical Reviewers are reused (GLORY-045). A request's new Reviewer is created once; crash re-entry must reuse the same ReviewerSessionId (FinalityReviewCohort). Retired/abandoned handles never re-fork under the same agent id.
hidden Reviewer.cancel: Owning HostForkRuntime.CancelAgent aborts the Host child. HostOwnedHidden keeps the Reviewer out of Manager list/join/guard cancel.
hidden Reviewer.retire: HandleController HandleRetired / HandleAbandoned on the hidden handle. HostForkRuntime.IsRetiredHandle blocks reuse of that agent id.
hidden Reviewer.handle: Yes, HostOwnedHidden. The handle exists for EXEC-009 identity but never enters Manager list/join/guard or parent RestoreHandles.
hidden Reviewer.companion: MAY. Role.Reviewer is Work, so CompanionTransform may attach a Blogger leaf when the session is not a satellite. The Reviewer handle itself stays HostOwnedHidden.
hidden Reviewer.crashReconcile: FinalityReviewCohort crash re-entry reuses the enlisted ReviewerSessionId (AdoptChild). HostForkRestart RestoreHandles skips HostOwnedHidden so the Reviewer is not resurrected inside the parent Manager runtime.

StrengthReplica.owner: Owning Work session (StrengthReplicaBinding.OwnerSessionId). InternalLeaf + Attached(StrengthReplica). At most one active replica per owner.
StrengthReplica.reusable: No. Decision-local leaf; must not reuse transcript across Strength decisions (STRENGTH-004/014).
StrengthReplica.cancel: StrengthReplicaRuntime abortReplica (AbortSession). Dispose completes in-flight as Cancelled. Owner session deletion / attempt abort cascades.
StrengthReplica.retire: StrengthRuntime.Retire removes owner and replica indexes atomically on terminal (removeState after complete).
StrengthReplica.handle: No. Not a public Handle and not a SatelliteKind case.
StrengthReplica.companion: No. No Companion, SyncDelegate, or nested Attached (STRENGTH-004/014).
StrengthReplica.crashReconcile: Process-local StrengthRuntime is not durable lifecycle authority. After crash do not reuse a replica transcript; a new decision creates a new child. Durable causality lives in Strength EventStore facts.

fork agent.reusable: No new fork under a retired or abandoned handle (IsRetiredHandle). Restart restores the same handle id and ChildSessionId (EXEC-009). Not a SyncDelegate reuse scope.
fork agent.cancel: Parent HostForkRuntime.CancelAgent: mailbox cancel plus AbortSession of the Host child.
fork agent.retire: HandleController is the single writer: HandleCompleted then HandleRetired, or HandleAbandoned.
fork agent.handle: Yes. DurableParentHandle; the agent handle id is the runtime agent id (HandleController.agentHandle).
fork agent.companion: MAY. A Work fork child is not a satellite, so CompanionTransform may attach a Blogger leaf.
fork agent.crashReconcile: HostForkRestart RestoreHandles → ChildRecoveryWorkflow; SessionRecoveryWorkflow.RestoreHandles. HostOwnedHidden handles are excluded from parent restore. Fail closed on missing proof.

Executor child.owner: Calling session via HostForkRuntime (Executor tool parent). Map/reduce workers are forked with Role.Executor through ExecutorSummarizeRuntime.asExecutorRuntime.
Executor child.reusable: No. Agent ids are content-addressed per spool chunk (exec- + digest); one-shot map/reduce workers.
Executor child.cancel: IExecutorRuntime.CancelAgent → HostForkRuntime.CancelAgent. Cancels one owned map/reduce agent without tearing down the runtime.
Executor child.retire: JoinWithPermit / AwaitAgentWithPermit completion then Handle retire on the fork path; cancel retires or abandons that agent handle.
Executor child.handle: Yes. Private Executor mailbox handles on HostForkRuntime. Never Manager Join — only permit-gated JoinWithPermit / AwaitAgentWithPermit.
Executor child.companion: No. Executor is an internal Role (AGENT-008); not a Work+Companion path.
Executor child.crashReconcile: FamilyRecoveryPermit required before join. FamilyBlocked fail closed; FamilyWaiting retries inside awaitAgent timeout. HostForkRestart restores DurableParentHandle children on the same fork path.
